verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Airbyte loading synced data into vector-store destinations or LLM-ready chunked or embedded formats. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: PyAirbyte loads into caches, Airbyte Agents and MCP let agents query live data, and a generic 'inference layers' marketing line names no capability. The axis applies to a data-pipeline product, so the lack of evidence makes this 'none'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, pipelines load into vector stores and LLM-ready formats so my agents can retrieve what was synced
